{{Top|leg}}
The '''Shoroni sapphire''' was a type of gem from the [[Shoroni system/Legends|Shoroni system]] that was either blue or green color in different light. [[Walon Vau]]'s [[Walon Vau's mother|mother]] owned a flawlessly cut one that he stole from the family security box in the [[Dressian Kiolsh Merchant Bank]]. The theft of the item gave Vau great pleasure as his mother would no longer have it. Vau gave it to [[Ordo Skirata]] to give to [[Besany Wennen]] as a gift as he thought it would suit her well. Ordo presented it to Besany moments before he asked her to marry him.
